title: CI never installs protoc, which persona-grpc's build.rs requires
description:
persona-grpc/build.rs calls tonic_build::configure().compile_protos(...). tonic-build 0.12.3 -> prost-build 0.13.5 (both in Cargo.lock) require a 'protoc' binary in PATH or $PROTOC; prost-build dropped the bundled protoc in 0.11.

.github/workflows/ci.yml installs no system packages on either ubuntu-latest or macos-latest, so every job that compiles persona-grpc (check matrix build/test/clippy, and the msrv job) depends on protoc happening to be present in the runner image. Nothing pins that.

It is also undocumented: grep for 'protoc' across README.md, DESIGN.md, AGENTS.md, Makefile and .github/ returns zero hits. A new contributor cloning the repo gets an opaque build.rs failure with no stated prerequisite.

Add an explicit protoc install step to CI and a prerequisites line to README.md.
